title: Ask HN: What non-IT/Software industries have benefitted the most from AI?
excerpt: I would think in any domain that used to suffer due to lack of a fuzzy, search.
content_html:
I would think in any domain that used to suffer due to lack of a fuzzy, search.

In cases where LLMs are used to generate stuff, when push comes to shove, LLMs fails to deliver. This is fundamental.

For example, if you talk to an LLM regarding any subject, it will appear like a scholar initially. But if you push it deep enough, you will notice that it is just circling. This is same for any domain..
